method.selection: 26 fixed cases: all 9 original local fixtures, all 16 existing course excerpts, and 1 fixed numbers light-noise variant. Failed/mixed/silence and uncertain negation are retained.
method.references: Course statuses come from per-row confirmed status and reviewedAt in outputs/quality-baseline-reviewed-v1/正式基准-v1.json, cross-checked with 人工听校原始导出.json and 人工修订记录.json. The stale all-pending template header is not used. Existing pending or uncertain references are not promoted.
method.syntheticScoring: Known TTS text is separate from human speech. negation remains unclear because the existing human review marked it uncertain; it is observed but excluded from WER. Mixed language is observed without English WER.
method.werNormalization: Lowercase; Unicode punctuation/symbols become spaces; whitespace word tokens. Number words are not equated to numeric digits. This differs from the older retrospective score normalization and results must not be compared without recomputing.
method.repeats: Use the same audio across both arms, three repeats. Repeats and the derived noise sample do not create additional independent human references.
method.semanticValidity: Existing meaning notes are checklists, not a new human semantic judgment of outputs. firstAccepted is an ASR quality-gate measure only.
